verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26969088 for Soony Interactive GmbH PO 4500318710 (dated 2026-08-05). It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 at 6.11 USD each: 8,500 pcs confirmed for 2026-09-03 and 10,000 pcs confirmed for 2026-09-07 (18,500 in total). Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: Terms contradict each other: the document says EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed. It also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under plain EXW the buyer would arrange and pay for these, so the cost allocation is unclear.
Freight, insurance and duties will be added to the invoice on top of the 6.11 USD unit price, so landed cost may be higher than the unit price implies.
The same material CMP-GAM-002 is split across two lines with different confirmed dates (2026-09-03 and 2026-09-07). The buyer should check this against the PO's requested dates and quantities.
The document has no issue date, and the quantity unit is not stated (the Qty column has no unit).
observations: Clean typed PDF, fully legible, with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The Qty column uses English-style thousands separators (8,500 and 10,000).
The PO order date 2026-08-05 appears in the header line and is not repeated per line.
Item descriptions wrap across lines in the table: 'Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5'.
